units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 12:18">Targ. Job XII, 18</cite> <he>שולשיל׳</he> Ms. (ed. <he>שוש׳</he>). Targ. II Esth. I, 2 <he>שוש׳</he>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 27a:11">Keth. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מהדר ליה למתא שושיל׳ וכ׳</he> they place around the town a chain and a dog &c. (to guard against surprise).

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:5">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>תן לי … וש׳ וכ׳</he> grant me (spare) Jabneh and her scholars and the chain (the family of scholars) of Rabban G.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שַׁלְשְׁלָוָון</he>, <he>שַׁלְשְׁלָוָותָא</he>, <he>שׁוּלְשְׁ׳</he>, <he>שׁוּשְׁ׳</he>, <he>שַׁלְשְׁלָן</he>, <cite ref="U01338"><he>שִׁילְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 6:21">Targ. I Kings VI, 21</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>שִׁישְׁלָן</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 7:23">Targ. Ez. VII, 23</cite> <he>שִׁלְשְׁ׳</he> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="U01402"><he>שִׁישְׁ׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:21">Targ. Jud. XVI, 21</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 40:19">Targ. Is. XL, 19</cite> (some ed. <he>שילשלין</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 118:27">Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 27</cite> <he>שִׁלְשְׁלָוָן</he> ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. <he>שושלוון</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 107:14">Ib. CVII, 14</cite> <he>שַׁלְשָׁלְוָתְהוֹן</he> (Ms. <he>שׁוּלְשְׁלָוַות׳</he>). Targ. II Esth. I, 2, end <he>שלשלוון</he> (some ed. <he>שַׁלְשָׁוָון</he>); a. fr.
